items.headline: Jordan Marshall says Michigan must run the ball
items.description: Marshall says the running game is Michigan's identity and can help QB Bryce Underwood.

items.headline: College football betting: How to bet Michigan-Oklahoma
items.description: Pamela Maldonado dives into the numbers and trends to find the best way to the Michigan-Oklahoma game in Ann Arbor.

items.headline: NCAA establishes 'standard timing protocol' in wake of Michigan win
items.description: The NCAA is establishing a new standard timing protocol in the wake of the controversial decision to award Michigan an extra second despite the broadcast clock showing zeros.

items.headline: No. 11 Oklahoma set for success vs. Michigan, all season long
items.description: The SEC Now crew believes John Mateer's improved technique and options, paired with OU's unforgiving defense, make an "ugly" combo for Michigan and all opponents to come.

items.headline: MAC decides to fight back, but it was always throwing stones at Goliath
items.description: Three days after the controversial finish, the MAC is asking that Western Michigan be declared Saturday's winner.

items.headline: WMU Public Safety Dept. posts joking 'robbery' crime log after Michigan loss
items.description: Western Michigan thought it had pulled off an iconic upset of Michigan at the Big House on Saturday night, but a dramatic plot twist had other plans.
